description: Print the number of days in a Gregorian month.
long_description: Returns Gregorian month length for a year and month. Use it when a Shell workflow needs month boundaries or the number of days in a date range. Supports the 4/100/400 leap-year rule and preserves the legacy 28-day result for February in year 0. Uses only Python's standard library. Requires exactly two integer arguments and month 1–12; it does not calculate dates or validate a wider application-specific year range.

description: Generate GrADS CTLs for configured Binary XY model outputs.
input: Run directory with input_cmf.nam; map params.txt; output variable registry.
output: One CTL per supported configured gridded Binary output.
long_description: Creates GrADS descriptors for configured CaMa-Flood Binary XY outputs. Use it before or after a Binary-output run to describe planned outputs or complete existing records. Reads the run Namelist, map geometry, and output_variables.csv; planned and existing modes are available. It does not convert NetCDF or vector outputs, modify model Binary data, or guarantee support for uncertain or special dimensions.

description: Generate GrADS CTLs for main Binary Restart files.
input: Run directory with input_cmf.nam, Binary Restart files, map params.txt, and restart registry.
output: Restart CTLs and, for Float64 input, a separate Float32 viewing copy.
long_description: Creates GrADS descriptors for supported main-file CaMa-Flood Binary Restarts. Use it to inspect existing Restart fields and their timestamp on a compatible map grid. It reads the Namelist, map geometry, and restart_variables.csv, and preserves source Restart files; Float64 input is copied to Float32 for GrADS viewing. It does not modify simulation state, create Restart data, or describe NetCDF Restart products.

description: Downscale CaMa-Flood flood depth or annual flood duration to an existing higher-resolution map grid.
input: Flood Depth: 2D NetCDF or single-record little-endian Float32 Binary flddph. Flood Duration: daily CF-time NetCDF flddph(time,lat,lon). Both require matching CaMa-Flood map layers.
output: Compressed NetCDF flood-depth or flood-duration product and optional comparison Figure.
long_description: Provides two separate workflows on existing higher-resolution CaMa-Flood map grids. Flood Depth maps a selected flddph field and optionally applies tributary/backwater adjustment and the permanent-water depth minimum. Flood Duration counts daily low-resolution flddph records above legacy strict thresholds, then maps the flddif-selected threshold onto high-resolution pixels using catmxy and flddif; it writes flood_duration days and a separate permanent_water mask and does not apply tributary or backwater fill. NetCDF and single-record Binary inputs are supported for Depth; daily CF-time NetCDF is required for Duration. The package does not reproject or resample the maps; the documented Mekong comparisons establish implementation fidelity for the tested map, period and extent only.
